entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look at how many there are... Are these[n]all prison cells?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And... what's that thing in the middle?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Whatever it is, it looks disgustingly grand...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There are no other passages leading out[n]of this room.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears this is our final destination...[n]the depths of Mementos.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: In that case, is the Treasure of Mementos[n]somewhere in here?
That should be the case.
I don't know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think you're right...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've never been here... but I can sense it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no mistaking that presence. If we[n]get rid of it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...If we get rid of it, the public should[n]come to its senses!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But something that large will be[n]impossible to carry out of here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just gotta make it disappear, right?[n]If we can't move it, then we'll just hafta[n]destroy it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah... That will work.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Once we do that, the entire Metaverse[n]is going to disappear, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is finally it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh. I guess it's no surprise we've been[n]discovered.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That thing isn't gonna sit back and let[n]itself get destroyed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even the inmates are starting to liven up.[n]How eerie... Are they planning something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That must mean this thing's gotta be the[n]Treasure. They saved us the trouble of[n]checkin'!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Hold on. Something's off.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shido said the masses are allowing[n]themselves to be held captive here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could they truly be operating this[n]gigantic system that eliminates intruders[n]on its own?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The prison guards and soldiers were very[n]organized too...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you trying to say that someone else[n]rules this place? Is it not the public?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What was that!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't have time to worry about that![n]Leave it for later!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, guys! We better not lose now!
